answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 467 Country: Pakistan Title: My wudhu doesnt remain for a long time, is there any permission to pray salat without wudhu? Question: My wudhu doesnt remain for a long time, is there any permission to pray salat without wudhu? Answer ID: 467 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 513/J) Please, confirm how long your wuzu remains? Does it not remain even a time of praying farz salah (i.e. 3-4 minutes)? Having received the details we shall have a say. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
